description: React component for sharing tasks via link, QR code, or calendar integration in a task management app.

methods.name: generateShareableLink
methods.description: Creates a compressed, shareable URL for a task, encoding task data and username.

methods.name: handleCopyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the generated share link to clipboard and shows a toast notification.

methods.name: handleShare
methods.description: Uses the Web Share API to share the task link via native sharing options.

methods.name: formatICSDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ICS calendar date string.

methods.name: handleAddToAppleCalendar
methods.description: Generates an ICS calendar event file for the task and triggers download.
